text: The doctor, a small woman, I think her name was Apiradee, if I remember correctly, was very kind, caring, and gave excellent advice. I was able to use my social security insurance without having to pay upfront.
I tried to use my social security benefits, but waited a long time for verification. In the end, they said it wasn't valid and I had to pay upfront.
author_name: จอมชาย วัฒนสุคนธ์

text: The doctor is incredibly lovely and gave excellent advice. She's gentle and attentive to patients. Highly recommended!
author_name: ลภัสรดา สุขสถิตย์ (Gibby)
